description: Implementation of the PersonService interface, providing CRUD operations for Person entities with transaction management and logging.

classes.name: PersonServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing business logic for managing Person entities, including fetching, adding, updating, and deleting persons with transaction support.

methods.name: fetchPersonsByPages
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of Person entities based on page number and size.

methods.name: getPersonById
methods.description: Fetches a Person by its unique ID; throws PersonNotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: addPerson
methods.description: Adds a new Person entity to the repository within a transaction.

methods.name: updatePerson
methods.description: Updates an existing Person's details identified by ID.

methods.name: deletePerson
methods.description: Deletes a Person entity by ID.
